errors.text_span: The gray line begins at approximately 40% at age 20
errors.evidence: The gray series ('in Deutschland geboren') starts closer to about 53–55% at age 20, not 40%.

errors.text_span: The light blue line commences at about 35% at age 20
errors.evidence: The light blue series ('zugewandert bis 2009') starts closer to about 35% only if using the leftmost point after 20; at age 20 itself it is about 35%, but the description is imprecise and the series immediately jumps much higher. This is a minor issue at most.

errors.text_span: The blue line starts at around 35% at age 20
errors.evidence: The blue series ('zugewandert seit 2010') starts closer to about 38–40% at age 20, not 35%.

errors.text_span: and then declines sharply to near 0% by age 68
